featured_reviews.review_text:
DON'T BUY ANYTHING FROM HERE!!!!
I recently had an extremely disappointing experience with this company regarding the installation of an aluminum door. Initially, they promised to deliver the door within two days. However, they failed to meet this deadline. When I contacted them after the delay, I was told it would take a few more days. At that point, I expressed my dissatisfaction and said I no longer wanted the door. They insisted that it was already in the making process and urged me not to cancel.

Ultimately, it took 15 days for the door to be installed, and when it finally arrived, it was damaged and had an unfinished color coating. Now, 17 days later, I am still waiting for the door to be properly installed.

This experience has been incredibly frustrating, and I strongly advise against paying them the full amount upfront. Their lack of punctuality and poor quality of work have been unacceptable.
